zh-Hant.title: 紙與光
zh-Hant.description: 紙品訂製工作室。從名片、婚禮邀請到禮盒，挑選紙材與加工，整理一份專屬印製需求。

en.title: Paper & Light
en.description: A bespoke print studio. Explore cards, invitations and gift packaging, compare stocks and finishes, and shape your print brief.

zh-Hant.title: 物形 FORME
zh-Hant.description: 不鏽鋼家飾品牌。比較燭台、花器與書擋的比例及表面處理，建立自己的選品清單。

en.title: FORME Objects
en.description: Steel objects for everyday rituals. Compare candleholders, vases and bookends, choose a finish, and build your collection shortlist.

zh-Hant.title: 夜航訊號
zh-Hant.description: 一夜三段電子聲響。瀏覽演出、探索場地，選擇票種並保存你的夜航行程。

en.title: Night Signal
en.description: Three electronic sets, one night. Meet the lineup, explore the venue, choose your tickets and save a personal night-out plan.

zh-Hant.title: 折光材料室
zh-Hant.description: 光學玻璃、曲面折射與空間材料選樣。比較清透、霧化和紋理，建立專屬選樣需求。

en.title: PRISM Materials
en.description: Optical glass and architectural finishes. Explore refraction, compare surfaces, and create a sample brief.

zh-Hant.title: 空型動態設計
zh-Hant.description: 讓品牌擁有自己的動作。探索識別、動態與數位服務，整理一份清楚的專案需求。

en.title: AERIFORM
en.description: Distinctive identities in motion. Explore brand, motion and digital services, then shape a project brief.

zh-Hant.title: 潮間帶
zh-Hant.description: 從潮池短線到望潮高徑，沿礁岸選擇導覽路線，替同行的人備好行前單。

en.title: TIDE TABLE
en.description: Follow the tide across a reef, compare three guided walks and prepare a field checklist for your group.

zh-Hant.title: 布邊
zh-Hant.description: 看緯線穿過打開的經線，比較平紋、斜紋與長浮緞紋，選布與色號做成提案用的布樣單。

en.title: SELVEDGE
en.description: Follow the shuttle through the warp. Compare three weaves and choose swatches and colourways for a client sample sheet.

zh-Hant.title: 果時
zh-Hant.description: 選一處讓銀匙切進果凍，看它托起透光的一口。從三款口味配齊六杯，下載自己的禮盒配方。

en.title: JELLY HOUR
en.description: Choose where the spoon cuts into the fruit jelly. Mix six cups from three flavours and take home your gift-box recipe.

zh-Hant.title: 疊印
zh-Hant.description: 刮刀走過，橘墨疊上鈷藍，紙上留下一張雙色海報。替下一場演出選圖、紙色與印量，帶走印件製作單。

en.title: AFTERIMAGE PRESS
en.description: See a squeegee pull orange ink over cobalt blue to print a gig poster. Choose the artwork, stock and edition size for your production sheet.

zh-Hant.title: 摺徑
zh-Hant.description: 從岸邊的一只攜行包，看船殼攤開、兩舷立起。依路線與同行人數選配摺疊皮艇，下載裝備清單。

en.title: FOLDLINE
en.description: Watch a carry pack unfold into a kayak, from the first released strap to the raised sides. Choose your boat and route, then download a packing list.

zh-Hant.title: 食刻
zh-Hant.description: 看月影掠過日輪，為學校或場館挑一場穹頂放映，匯出片單、場次與設備需求。

en.title: UMBRA DIAL
en.description: Follow the Moon across the Sun, choose a dome show for your venue and export a programme with times and equipment needs.

zh-Hant.title: 夜行線
zh-Hant.description: 從黃銅臥鋪車窗望見阿爾卑斯雪峰、瀨戶內海夜霧與北極光原野，比較跨國臥鋪鐵道行程並匯出提案單。

en.title: SLEEPER LINE
en.description: Watch alpine peaks, coastal mist and northern lights pass a brass sleeper carriage window, compare rail journeys and export a proposal.

zh-Hant.title: 群島航誌
zh-Hant.description: 俯瞰宮古藍珊瑚礁、愛琴海白崖與帛琉牛奶湖的水光與帆船航跡，規劃跳島航程並匯出航行企劃書。

en.title: ARCHIPELAGO LOG
en.description: Explore aerial coral lagoons with shimmering water caustics and catamaran routes, compare island voyages and export a dossier.

zh-Hant.title: 等高線行旅
zh-Hant.description: 在立體陰影瑞士等高線地形圖上看健行路線沿稜線推進至主峰，比較三條山岳遠征並下載行程與裝備清單。

en.title: CONTOUR EXPEDITION
en.description: Follow a signal-orange ridge trail across a 3D hillshaded topographic map, compare guided alpine treks and export a gear checklist.
